bank_reconciliation_rule_target.name: bank_reconciliation_rule_target
bank_reconciliation_rule_target.value: "bank_reconciliation_rule"."accountId" IS NOT NULL OR "bank_reconciliation_rule"."partnerId" IS NOT NULL

journal_entry_fiscal_year_lifecycle_uniq.name: journal_entry_fiscal_year_lifecycle_unique
journal_entry_fiscal_year_lifecycle_uniq.where: "journal_entry"."sourceType" IN ('fiscalYearRegularization', 'fiscalYearClosing', 'fiscalYearOpening') AND "journal_entry"."reversesEntryId" IS NULL AND "journal_entry"."reversedAt" IS NULL

recurring_template_party_valid.name: recurring_template_party_valid
recurring_template_party_valid.value: ("recurring_template"."kind" = 'SALES_INVOICE' AND "recurring_template"."customerId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("recurring_template"."kind" = 'EXPENSE' AND "recurring_template"."supplierPartnerId" IS NOT NULL)

supplier_invoice_supplier_document_canon.name: supplier_invoice_supplier_document_canonical_unique
supplier_invoice_supplier_document_canon.where: "supplier_invoice"."supplierIdentityKey" IS NOT NULL AND "supplier_invoice"."supplierDocumentNumberNormalized" IS NOT NULL AND "supplier_invoice"."status" <> 'VOID'

verifactu_record_chain_link.name: verifactu_record_chain_link
verifactu_record_chain_link.value: ("verifactu_record"."sequence" = 1 AND "verifactu_record"."previousRecordId" IS NULL AND "verifactu_record"."previousHash" IS NULL) OR ("verifactu_record"."sequence" > 1 AND "verifactu_record"."previousRecordId" IS NOT NULL AND "verifactu_record"."previousHash" IS NOT NULL)
